notes: Fiscal year 2024 ended December 29, 2024 (52-week year; matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Ownership is from the 2025 proxy (filed March 12, 2025), as of February 25, 2025, when 2,409,847,729 shares were outstanding. DUATO: less than 1% (the proxy says each listed individual owns less than 1%; no percentage is given), so pctEconomic is null. His 1,395,264 shares include 987,499 shares underlying options or stock units exercisable or vesting within 60 days. Because Mr. Duato and Mr. Wolk serve as trustees of Johnson Family Trusts, they are deemed to 'control' an additional 4,952,871 shares in which they have no economic interest; those shares are not in his figure. HOLDERS: the proxy bases the 5% holders solely on Schedule 13G filings from January and February 2024, so the percentages are stale. The holding dates come from the 13Gs themselves: Vanguard, December 29, 2023 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/200406/000110465924021263/tv01257-johnsonjohnson.htm); BlackRock, December 31, 2023 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/200406/000108636424004277/us4781601046_012624.txt); State Street, 12/31/2023 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/200406/000009375124000440/Johnson_and_Johnson.txt). BUYBACKS: the 10-K says its open-market common stock purchases 'are made as part of a systematic plan to meet the needs of the Company's compensation programs'; the $2,432m is the full cash-flow line. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow add-back of $1,176m equals the compensation cost charged against income in the stock-compensation note. PLAN: null; no broad employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K. GEOGRAPHY values are rounded from millions.
